title: Policy administration preserves the acceptance-evaluation policy across assurance and rule-set changes and loads the active policy once
outcome: Policy administration preserves the acceptance-evaluation policy across assurance and rule-set changes and loads the active policy once
acceptance: a policy_admin test enables acceptance evaluation, changes the required assurance, then changes the obligation rule set, and reads back the policy with acceptance_evaluation preserved while verify_all stays healthy
set_required_control_assurance reuses its single load of the active policy version in the unchanged-assurance branch

completion.summary: acceptance_evaluation_policy_survives_assurance_and_rule_set_changes enables an observed, source-fresh two-mode policy, changes the required assurance, changes the obligation rule set, records a no-op receipt, and reads the evaluation policy unchanged with verify_all healthy and a healthy reopen (a pin of already-correct preservation, passed at RED time and disclosed as such); set_required_control_assurance reuses its single load of the active policy. GREEN logs/20 and /22.
